hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.stdout // .tool_response.output // empty' | grep -oP 'https://github\.com/[^ ]+/pull/\d+' | { read -r url; if [ -n "$url" ]; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PostToolUse\",\"additionalContext\":\"A PR was just created at $url. You MUST now invoke the pr-review-toolkit:review-pr skill to review this PR before continuing.\"}}"; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true

url=$(gh pr view --json url -q .url 2>/dev/null) && if [ -n "$url" ]; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PostToolUse\",\"additionalContext\":\"Code was pushed to PR at $url. You MUST now invoke the pr-review-toolkit:review-pr skill to review the updated PR before continuing.\"}}"; fi 2>/dev/null || true

git fetch origin main && git rebase origin/main 2>&1 || echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Rebase on origin/main failed. Resolve conflicts before creating the PR."}}'

CMD=$(cat | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['tool_input']['command'])") && PR_NUM=$(echo "$CMD" | grep -oE '[0-9]+' | head -1) && REPO=$(echo "$CMD" | grep -oE -- '--repo [^ ]+' | sed 's/--repo //' || echo '') && if [ -z "$REPO" ]; then REPO=$(git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null | sed 's/.*github.com[:\/]//;s/.git$//'); fi && if gh pr checks "$PR_NUM" --repo "$REPO" 2>&1 | grep -q 'fail'; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"PR #%s has failing CI checks. Fix them before merging."}}' "$PR_NUM"; fi
